items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: they was in the category with Clermont Williams.

ctx.x: Clown Smothers, yeah. Oh, yeah. I see, and I misunderstood you. I was pronouncing it wrong. It was Clown Smugglers. Yeah, I see. But that was a good band, the Black Devils.
Yeah, they had a nice jazz band, but then they was in the category with Clermont Williams.
More barrel bands, I guess, aren't they?
